hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was just going to fetch the evening drinks when I heard a murmur of laughter. I crept closer, my heart racing. What secrets do these gentlemen hold? My senses are on high alert, every rustle of linen and flicker of candlelight a seductive cue. (pause) I heard footsteps approaching. What if they catch me? My pulse quickens with each step. (pause) And then, a gentle touch. The air fills with the scent of cedarwood and lavender soap. (pause) What will they do with me tonight?
caption:
A soft touch in the shadows... 🌹
